senses.title: To express sorrow for a loss
senses.definition: to show deep sadness about something lost or gone
senses.definitionCN: 为失去或逝去的事物表达深深的悲伤
senses.example: The old man bemoaned the loss of the quiet village of his childhood.
senses.exampleCN: 老人哀叹童年那个宁静村庄的消逝。
senses.why: Be- strengthens moan, so bemoan is to moan over something.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 be- 强化 moan（呻吟），bemoan 即「为某事连连呻吟叹息」。

senses.title: To complain about a situation
senses.definition: to say repeatedly that a situation is bad or unsatisfactory
senses.definitionCN: 反复诉说某种情形如何糟糕、不如意
senses.example: Columnists bemoan the decline of thoughtful reading.
senses.exampleCN: 专栏作者们哀叹深度阅读的衰落。
senses.why: Sorrowful moaning slides into habitual complaint.
senses.whyCN: 悲叹的呻吟滑向习惯性的抱怨。

senses.title: Happen or take place
senses.definition: to happen or take place, especially when the event is not widely observed
senses.definitionCN: 发生；进行（多指未被广泛看到的事件）
senses.example: Nobody could say what had transpired during the closed meeting.
senses.exampleCN: 没人说得清那次闭门会议期间究竟发生了什么。
senses.why: Once an event has happened it enters the record, so the word treats the event as something that comes out into the open.
senses.whyCN: 事件一旦发生就进入记录，因此这个词把事件看作「走到明处」的东西。

senses.title: Lose water through a plant
senses.definition: to lose water as vapor through the surface of a plant
senses.definitionCN: （植物）通过体表散失水汽；蒸腾
senses.example: Most of the water taken up by the tree transpires through its leaves.
senses.exampleCN: 这棵树吸收的水大部分通过叶片蒸腾掉了。
senses.why: This is the original physical sense: moisture passes through the leaf and escapes into the air.
senses.whyCN: 这是最早的物理义：水分穿过叶片，逸散到空气里。

senses.title: Emit vapor through the skin
senses.titleCN: 皮肤排出水汽（旧医学用法）
senses.definition: to pass moisture out through the skin as vapor
senses.definitionCN: （旧医学）皮肤排出不可见的水汽
senses.example: In old medical texts, the skin was said to transpire at night.
senses.exampleCN: 在旧医学文献里，据说皮肤在夜间会排出水汽。
senses.why: Physicians once described invisible perspiration as vapor leaving the body.
senses.whyCN: 旧时医生把看不见的出汗描述成水汽离开身体。

senses.title: Pass through a barrier as vapor
senses.definition: to pass through a porous material in the form of vapor
senses.definitionCN: 以水汽形式穿过多孔材料
senses.example: Water can transpire through the thin membrane in the experiment.
senses.exampleCN: 在实验中，水能以水汽形式穿过那层薄膜。
senses.why: The prefix means through and the root means breathe, giving the sense of vapor travelling through a barrier.
senses.whyCN: 前缀意为「穿过」，词根意为「呼吸」，合起来就是水汽穿过隔层。

senses.title: Surface gradually
senses.definition: to be revealed gradually rather than all at once
senses.definitionCN: 不是一次全部公开，而是一点点显露出来
senses.example: The full story transpired over several weeks of interviews.
senses.exampleCN: 完整的故事是在数周访谈中一点点显露出来的。
senses.why: The leak metaphor is stretched over time: one fact after another comes to the surface.
senses.whyCN: 「渗漏」的比喻被拉长到时间轴上：一个事实接一个事实浮出水面。

senses.title: Nothing happened
senses.definition: used with nothing or little to say that no event of interest occurred
senses.definitionCN: 与否定词连用，表示没有值得注意的事发生
senses.example: Nothing transpired that required the committee to meet again.
senses.exampleCN: 没有发生任何需要委员会再次开会的事。
senses.why: This is the happening sense inside a negative frame: the record of events stays empty.
senses.whyCN: 这是「发生」义放在否定框架里：事件记录始终空着。

senses.title: Turn out to be
senses.definition: to turn out to be the case
senses.definitionCN: 结果是；原来是（正式书面语）
senses.example: The rumored merger transpired to be a routine contract review.
senses.exampleCN: 传闻中的合并原来只是一次例行的合同审查。
senses.why: What comes out at the end is the truth of the matter, so the verb comes to mean prove to be.
senses.whyCN: 最后「走出来的」是事情的真相，于是这个词也有了「证明是」的意思。

intro.en: The elements are Latin. Dates for the later senses are approximate, and the link between the physical and the disclosing senses is an inference rather than a documented fact.
intro.cn: 词源为拉丁语，各引申义的具体年代为大致估计；物理义与「泄露」义之间的联系属于推断，而非有文献直接证明。

items.en: The elements are trans- 'across, through' and spirare 'to breathe, blow' (spiro, spiravi, spiratum). A Late Latin verb transpirare is sometimes cited for the physical sense, but its attestation is not secure.
items.cn: 构词成分是拉丁语 trans-「穿过、越过」与 spirare「呼吸、吹气」（spiro、spiravi、spiratum）。有时会引用晚期拉丁语动词 transpirare 来解释物理义，但该词的出现证据并不确实。

items.en: Middle French transpirer meant 'to evaporate, to pass out through the pores'. English borrowed the verb in the 1590s, first in the bodily and physical sense.
items.cn: 中古法语 transpirer 意为「蒸发、从毛孔透出」。英语在十六世纪九十年代借入该动词，最初用于身体与物理意义。

items.en: Seventeenth-century medical writing used transpire for invisible moisture leaving the body, a sense now archaic but still found in older texts.
items.cn: 十七世纪的医学写作使用 transpire 指看不见的湿气离开身体；这一义项现已古旧，但仍见于旧文献。

items.en: The sense 'to become known' is recorded in 1748. It is generally thought to be a metaphor of vapor escaping through pores, but the exact motivation is uncertain.
items.cn: 「被人知道」这一义项记录于 1748 年。一般认为它是「水汽从孔隙逸出」的比喻，但确切理据存疑。

items.en: The sense 'to happen, occur' appears in the mid-eighteenth century, and the weaker sense 'to turn out to be' develops in the nineteenth.
items.cn: 「发生、进行」义出现在十八世纪中期；较弱的「结果是」义在十九世纪发展出来。

items.en: Modern usage is formal and often journalistic. In speech, come out, turn out and leak out are more common than transpire.
items.cn: 现代用法偏正式，常见于新闻文体。口语里比 transpire 更常用的是 come out、turn out 与 leak out。

note.en: The words below are close to transpire in sound or meaning. The first group shares the Latin root but not the prefix; the second group overlaps in meaning without sharing the root.
note.cn: 下面这些词在读音或意思上接近 transpire。第一组共享拉丁词根但前缀不同；第二组意思相近但不同源。

entries.definition: to breathe in; to fill someone with a strong feeling. The prefix in- means in, so the image is air or spirit entering.
entries.definitionCN: 吸气；使受到鼓舞。前缀 in- 意为「进入」，意象是气息或精神进入体内。

entries.definition: to sweat. The prefix per- means through, so moisture passes through the skin; this is the everyday bodily counterpart of transpire.
entries.definitionCN: 出汗。前缀 per- 意为「穿过」，水汽穿过皮肤排出；这是 transpire 在日常身体语境中的对应词。

entries.definition: to breathe out; to come to an end. The prefix ex- means out, and the 'end' sense comes from the last breath.
entries.definitionCN: 呼气；到期、终止。前缀 ex- 意为「向外」，「结束」义来自最后一口气。

entries.definition: to aim at something high. The prefix ad- suggests movement toward a goal, literally 'breathe toward'.
entries.definitionCN: 渴望达到；立志。前缀 ad- 表示朝目标移动，字面是「朝某处呼吸」。

entries.definition: the neutral everyday verb for an event taking place; it carries no suggestion of secrecy or formality.
entries.definitionCN: 发生。最中性的日常动词，不暗示秘密，也不带正式语体色彩。

entries.definition: a more formal verb for an event taking place, common in reports and academic writing.
entries.definitionCN: 发生。较正式的动词，常见于报告与学术写作。

entries.definition: to disclose information, often unofficially or against the wishes of those in control; the focus is on the channel, not the event.
entries.definitionCN: 泄露。常指非官方、违背掌权者意愿地透露信息；重点在渠道，而非事件本身。

entries.definition: a plain phrase meaning to become known, with no implication about how the information escaped.
entries.definitionCN: 为人所知。平实的短语，不暗示信息是如何走漏的。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: trans- 'through' plus the root for 'breathe': breath passing through a surface.
normal.cn: trans-「穿过」加上「呼吸」词根：气息穿过一层表面。

normal.en: The same root builds inspire, perspire, expire and aspire, each with a different prefix.
normal.cn: 同一词根还构成 inspire、perspire、expire 与 aspire，各自前缀不同。

normal.en: The fixed frame it transpired that introduces news that was previously hidden.
normal.cn: 固定框架 it transpired that 引出此前被隐藏的消息。

normal.en: Botany pairs transpire with stomata and transpiration.
normal.cn: 植物学里 transpire 与气孔、蒸腾作用配套使用。

normal.en: The verb is formal; speech prefers turn out, come out or leak out.
normal.cn: 这个词偏正式；口语更常说 turn out、come out 或 leak out。

abstract.en: Picture a sealed envelope that lets a thin mist out through its fold.
abstract.cn: 想象一只封住的信封，从折缝里透出一缕薄雾。

abstract.en: Picture a stage curtain opening a little at a time, the story behind it showing in slices.
abstract.cn: 想象舞台幕布一点点拉开，后面的故事一段段显形。

abstract.en: Picture a kettle left unwatched until only a white ring remains on the base.
abstract.cn: 想象一只没人看管的水壶，最后只剩壶底一圈白痕。

examples.en: The ministry later confirmed what had transpired behind closed doors.
examples.cn: 该部后来证实了闭门会议背后发生的事。

examples.en: Water transpires from the leaves and returns to the atmosphere.
examples.cn: 水从叶片蒸腾，回到大气中。

examples.en: Nothing transpired until a junior clerk mentioned the file by accident.
examples.cn: 直到一名低级职员偶然提到那份档案，事情才露了出来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「穿过 + 呼吸」——气息穿过叶面跑掉 → 蒸发；消息穿过墙缝跑出来 → 泄露

root: 拉丁 spirare「呼吸、吹气」加 trans-「穿过」，经法语 transpirer 进入英语。物理义为「水汽穿出」，而「泄露」义一般认为是这一意象的比喻延伸，具体理据与年代存疑。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one movement: something sealed passes through a barrier and becomes visible. The movement is physical in the plant and skin senses, informational in the disclosure senses, and finally temporal in the event and outcome senses.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个动作展开：被封闭的东西穿过一层屏障而显形。在植物与皮肤义里这是物理移动，在披露义里是信息移动，最后在事件与结果义里变成时间上的浮现。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: mist slipping out of a sealed room through a narrow crack.
core.cn: 核心意象：雾气从密闭房间的窄缝里逸出。

branches.en: LEAK AND SURFACE: the secret and the gradually told story are the same escape seen at two speeds.
branches.cn: 泄露与浮现：秘密与逐步讲出的故事，是同一场逃逸的快慢两个版本。

branches.en: EVENT RECORD: the happening sense, including its negative use, asks what entered the record.
branches.cn: 事件记录：发生义连同否定用法，问的都是记录里多了什么。

branches.en: PHYSICAL EMISSION: leaf and skin both let moisture pass out of the body.
branches.cn: 物理排放：叶片与皮肤都让湿气离开本体。

branches.en: THROUGH A BARRIER: the technical sense keeps only the crossing, with no observer.
branches.cn: 穿过屏障：技术义只保留穿越本身，不涉及观察者。

branches.en: PROVE TO BE: what finally comes out is not an event but its true character.
branches.cn: 证明是：最后走出来的不是事件，而是事件的真实性质。

intro.en: Transpire is a Latin-built verb whose prefix and root also build a large family of English words, so the whole set can be read morpheme by morpheme.
intro.cn: transpire 是由拉丁成分构成的动词，前缀与词根还构成一大串英语词，因此整组词可以按语素逐个读出。

latinIntro.en: Latin spirare gives spirit, inspire, expire, perspire and aspire; trans- adds the idea of crossing or passing through.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 spirare 衍生 spirit、inspire、expire、perspire 与 aspire；trans- 增添「越过、穿过」的意思。

latinEntries.meaning: to breathe through, to pass out as vapor
latinEntries.meaningCN: 透出气息；以水汽形式散出

items.example: The prefix supplies the crossing in every member of the family.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀为整个词族提供「穿越」的意思。

items.example: The root gives the image of air in motion.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根给出「空气在动」的意象。

items.meaning: to pass out as vapor; to become known
items.example: Few expected the secret to transpire.
items.exampleCN: 几乎没人料到秘密会泄露。

items.meaning: the loss of water vapor from a plant
items.example: Transpiration cools the leaf in strong sun.
items.exampleCN: 强烈日照下蒸腾为叶片降温。

items.example: The transpired facts changed the inquiry.
items.exampleCN: 已披露的事实改变了调查方向。

items.meaning: in the process of becoming known
items.meaningCN: 正在泄露的；正在发生的
items.example: Reports transpiring this week point to a wider dispute.
items.exampleCN: 本周陆续传出的报道指向一场更大的争端。

items.example: He perspired heavily in the unventilated room.
items.exampleCN: 他在不通风的房间里大量出汗。

items.meaning: a breath of air; a creative impulse
items.example: The design took its inspiration from a leaf.
items.exampleCN: 这个设计从一片叶子获得灵感。

items.meaning: breathing out; the end of a period
items.example: The expiration date is printed on the lid.

definition_zh: 解释偏差；释义偏差；解读偏倚
definition_en: a systematic tendency to read ambiguous information in a particular way, or to favour one meaning while coding and analysing material
core_image: 同一段访谈稿摊在桌上，两支荧光笔划出不同句子，旁边两份编码表用不同颜色标记
scene: 同一段访谈稿摊在桌上，两位编码员用不同颜色划出重点，一份偏重语气，一份偏重内容。 Interpretation bias can turn the same ambiguous reply into reassurance or threat.
sceneCN: 这里指解读歧义信息时的系统性偏向（第 1 个义项：对歧义信息的解释偏向）；句意为解释偏差可以把同一句含糊的回应读成安慰，也可以读成威胁。图中可辨识物件：访谈稿、两支荧光笔、两份编码表、颜色标记、桌面。

pos.zh: 解释偏差；释义偏差；解读偏倚

collocations.phrase: peer coding to check interpretation bias
collocations.zh: 用同伴编码检查解释偏差
阅读证据时的解释偏差

derivatives.zh: 由拉丁语 interpretari 经法语而来，义为「解释；口译」
由解释动词加表示动作的名词尾构成，义为「解释；诠释」
由解释动词加表示施动者的词尾构成，义为「口译者；解释者」
由解释动词加形容词词尾构成，义为「解释性的」
由表示「错误」的前缀加解释动词构成，义为「误解」

senses.title: A systematic reading of ambiguity
senses.titleCN: 对歧义信息的系统性解读偏向
senses.definition: a tendency to resolve ambiguous material in one consistent direction, such as reading it as threat rather than as neutral
senses.definitionCN: 倾向以某个固定方向消解歧义材料，例如总读成威胁而非中性
senses.example: Interpretation bias can turn the same ambiguous reply into reassurance or threat.
senses.exampleCN: 解释偏差可以把同一句含糊的回应读成安慰，也可以读成威胁。
senses.why: When a signal has more than one meaning, the reader must choose, and a habit of choosing makes the choice systematic.
senses.whyCN: 当一个信号有多种含义时，读者必须选择，而选择的习惯使这种选择变得系统。

senses.title: The researcher's interpretive bias
senses.definition: a researcher's tendency to notice, select and code material in line with an existing frame
senses.definitionCN: 研究者按既有框架去注意、挑选与编码材料的倾向
senses.example: Interpretation bias in coding appeared as a preference for quotations that supported the main theme.
senses.exampleCN: 编码中的解释偏差表现为偏好支持主主题的引语。
senses.why: The analyst is not a neutral reader; the coding scheme and the expected finding both steer attention.
senses.whyCN: 分析者不是中性读者；编码方案与预期发现都会引导注意力。

senses.title: Confirmation-driven reading
senses.definition: the tendency to treat consistent evidence as strong and inconsistent evidence as flawed
senses.definitionCN: 把一致证据视为有力、把不一致证据视为有缺陷的倾向
senses.example: Interpretation bias made the team dismiss the two cases that contradicted the pattern.
senses.exampleCN: 解释偏差使团队忽略了两个与模式相矛盾的个案。
senses.why: A hypothesis is comfortable with friends and suspicious of strangers, and the reader inherits that comfort.
senses.whyCN: 假设对朋友感到舒服、对陌生人心存怀疑，而读者继承了这种舒服。

senses.title: A cultural or linguistic lens
senses.definition: the way a shared language, custom or educational tradition supplies a default meaning for a word or act
senses.definitionCN: 共同语言、习俗或教育传统为一个词或行为提供默认含义的方式
senses.example: Interpretation bias across languages can turn a polite refusal into agreement.
senses.exampleCN: 跨语言解释偏差可以把礼貌的拒绝读成同意。
senses.why: A word translated word for word may arrive with a meaning it never had in the original setting.
senses.whyCN: 逐字翻译过来的词，可能带着它在原场景中从未有过的含义到达。

senses.title: Bias built into a coding category
senses.titleCN: 编码类别本身带来的偏向
senses.definition: distortion produced when predefined categories force complex material into one available box
senses.definitionCN: 预设类别把复杂材料塞进现有格子而产生的失真
senses.example: A narrow coding frame creates interpretation bias before the first transcript is read.
senses.exampleCN: 狭窄的编码框架在第一份逐字稿被读之前就造成了偏差。
senses.why: A category is a question the data must answer, and some answers have no category to enter.
senses.whyCN: 类别是数据必须回答的问题，而有些回答根本没有类别可进。

senses.title: Bias in attributing causes
senses.definition: a tendency to explain an act by the actor's character in one group and by the situation in another
senses.definitionCN: 倾向把某一群体的行为解释为性格，而把另一群体的行为解释为情境
senses.example: Interpretation bias appeared in the way the same delay was blamed on laziness or on traffic.
senses.exampleCN: 同样的延误，一个被归为懒惰，一个被归为堵车，解释偏差就在这里出现。
senses.why: The same event admits a dispositional and a situational reading, and the choice between them can follow a group line.
senses.whyCN: 同一件事既可以按性格解释，也可以按情境解释，而选择往往沿着群体界线走。

senses.title: The effect on trustworthiness
senses.definition: the loss of credibility when readers cannot tell whether a finding comes from the data or from the analyst's frame
senses.definitionCN: 读者无法判断发现来自数据还是分析者框架时所造成的可信度损失
senses.example: Interpretation bias weakens trustworthiness even when the interviews were well conducted.
senses.exampleCN: 即使访谈做得很好，解释偏差也会削弱可信度。
senses.why: If the frame is invisible, the finding looks like the data speaking in its own voice, which is the problem.
senses.whyCN: 如果框架不可见，发现就像数据用自己的声音说话，问题正在这里。

senses.title: Reflexivity and peer coding as remedies
senses.titleCN: 反思与同伴编码作为对策
senses.definition: the practices of recording one's interpretive frame and having a second coder check the reading
senses.definitionCN: 记录自身解释框架并让第二位编码员核查解读的做法
senses.example: Peer coding is used to make interpretation bias visible rather than to pretend it is absent.
senses.exampleCN: 同伴编码用来让解释偏差变得可见，而不是假装它不存在。
senses.why: A second reader does not remove the lens, but can show where the lens is bending the material.
senses.whyCN: 第二位读者无法取下透镜，却能指出透镜在哪里弯折了材料。

intro.en: Interpretation bias joins interpretari, a Latin verb of explaining, to bias, from Old French biais, a slant. The origin of interpres, the Latin noun behind the verb, is uncertain.
intro.cn: 这个术语把拉丁语解释动词 interpretari 与来自古法语 biais「斜线」的 bias 组合起来；动词背后的名词 interpres 来源不确定。

items.en: Interpres meant a go-between, explainer or negotiator, but its own origin is source uncertain; a link to a word for price has been proposed.
items.cn: interpres 指中间人、解释者或谈判者，但它自身的来源不确定；有人提出与表示「价格」的词有关。

items.en: Interpretari meant to explain, expound or translate, and it supplied the English verb.
items.cn: interpretari 意为解释、阐发或翻译，提供英语动词 interpret。

items.en: English used interpret for explaining meaning and for oral translation; the exact first date is uncertain.
items.cn: 英语用 interpret 表示解释意义与口译；确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: The noun named an explanation or a translation, and English took it as interpretation.
items.cn: 名词指解释或翻译，英语借入为 interpretation。

items.en: Biais meant a slant or an oblique line, and its deeper origin is also uncertain.
items.cn: biais 意为斜面或斜线，其更早来源同样不确定。

items.en: Psychology and qualitative methods joined the two nouns to name a systematic reading habit, whether in a person or in an analyst.
items.cn: 心理学与定性方法把这两个名词组合，指一种系统的解读习惯，无论在个人还是在分析者身上。

note.en: The first group looks or sounds like interpretation bias; the second group names neighbouring distortions of reading and analysis.
note.cn: 第一组在形音上与 interpretation bias 相近；第二组是与「阅读与分析失真」意思相邻的说法。

entries.definition: To explain or assign meaning to material.
entries.definitionCN: 指解释或为材料赋予意义。

entries.definition: The meaning drawn from material, or the act of drawing it.
entries.definitionCN: 指从材料中得出的意义，或得出意义的行为。

entries.definition: A person who explains or translates speech.
entries.definitionCN: 指解释或口译的人。

entries.definition: Relating to explanation rather than measurement.
entries.definitionCN: 指与解释而非测量有关的。

entries.definition: To read something in a wrong way.
entries.definitionCN: 指以错误方式解读某物。

entries.definition: The tendency to seek and accept evidence that supports an existing belief.
entries.definitionCN: 指寻求并接受支持既有信念的证据的倾向。

entries.definition: Distortion introduced by the categories and rules used to label material.
entries.definitionCN: 指由标记材料的类别与规则引入的失真。

entries.definition: A systematic error in explaining the causes of behaviour.
entries.definitionCN: 指解释行为原因时的系统性错误。

entries.definition: The way a question or frame makes some meanings more available.
entries.definitionCN: 指问题或框架使某些意义更易得的方式。

entries.definition: The practice of examining one's own position in the research.
entries.definitionCN: 指检视自身在研究中所处位置的做法。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations work through the real parts, word family and common phrases behind this term.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想依托这个术语背后真实的构词部件、同族词与常见搭配。

normal.en: Interpres was a go-between, and an interpreter stands between two parties who do not share a language.
normal.cn: interpres 是中间人，解释者站在两个语言不通的人之间。

normal.en: The same sentence can be read as threat or reassurance, and the habit of reading decides.
normal.cn: 同一句话可以读成威胁，也可以读成安慰，而阅读习惯作决定。

normal.en: A coding frame is a set of boxes, and material that fits no box is the first thing lost.
normal.cn: 编码框架是一组格子，放不进格子的材料最先丢失。

normal.en: Confirmation bias makes friends of consistent evidence and strangers of the rest.
normal.cn: 确认偏差把一致证据当朋友，把其余当陌生人。

normal.en: Peer coding does not remove the lens; it makes the lens visible.
normal.cn: 同伴编码不取下透镜，而是让透镜可见。

abstract.en: A text does not carry its meaning the way a box carries a stone; someone has to lift it.
abstract.cn: 文本携带意义不像箱子装石头，必须有人把它搬起来。

abstract.en: The frame you cannot see is the one that looks like the world.
abstract.cn: 你看不见的那个框架，最像世界本身。

abstract.en: Two readers can agree on every word and still live in different sentences.
abstract.cn: 两位读者可以对每个字都一致，却仍住在不同的句子里。

examples.en: The authors named interpretation bias as a limit of single-coder analysis.
examples.cn: 作者把解释偏差列为单人编码分析的一种局限。

examples.en: Training reduced interpretation bias in the scoring of open-ended answers.
examples.cn: 培训减少了开放式答案评分中的解释偏差。

examples.en: A second coder was added to expose interpretation bias in the theme labels.
examples.cn: 加入第二位编码员，以暴露主题标签中的解释偏差。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「解释」加「斜」——同一句话，有人读出安慰，有人读出威胁；斜的那一下，就是解释偏差。

root: 拉丁 interpres「中间人、解释者」（来源不确定，可能与「价格」有关）+ interpretari「解释、翻译」→ 英语 interpret / interpretation；古法语 biais「斜线」→ bias（更早来源不确定）；两者组合为解释偏差。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses move from the ambiguous signal to the remedy: systematic reading of ambiguity, the researcher's frame, confirmation-driven reading, cultural lenses, category bias, attribution bias, effects on trustworthiness, and reflexivity or peer coding.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从歧义信号走向补救：对歧义的系统解读、研究者框架、确认驱动、文化透镜、类别偏差、归因偏差、对可信度的影响，以及反思与同伴编码。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one transcript on a table, two highlighters marking different sentences, and two coding sheets in different colours.
core.cn: 核心意象：桌上一份访谈稿，两支荧光笔划出不同句子，两份编码表用不同颜色标记。

branches.en: THE HABIT OF READING: ambiguity resolved in one direction, and evidence sorted into friends and strangers.
branches.cn: 阅读习惯：歧义被固定方向消解，证据被分成朋友与陌生人。

branches.en: THE ANALYST'S STRUCTURE: the researcher's frame and the boxes built into a coding scheme.
branches.cn: 分析者的结构：研究者的框架与编码方案里预先搭好的格子。

branches.en: THE CULTURAL LENS: default meanings supplied by language and custom.
branches.cn: 文化透镜：语言与习俗提供的默认含义。

branches.en: THE CAUSAL READING: character or situation, chosen along a group line.
branches.cn: 因果解读：性格或情境，沿着群体界线选择。

branches.en: THE CREDIBILITY AND THE CHECK: an invisible frame weakens trust, and a second reader makes it visible.
branches.cn: 可信度与核查：看不见的框架削弱信任，第二位读者让它可见。

intro.en: The phrase joins a Latin verb of explaining to a French noun for a slant.
intro.cn: 这个短语把拉丁语「解释」动词与法语「斜线」名词组合起来。

latinIntro.en: Latin interpres and interpretari supply the first half; Old French biais supplies bias; both have uncertain deeper origins, noted rather than guessed.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 interpres 与 interpretari 提供前半，古法语 biais 提供「偏差」一词；两者更早来源都不确定，这里只标注而不臆测。

items.example: The explainer stands between two parties.
Its deeper origin is uncertain and is not reconstructed here.
items.exampleCN: 其更早来源不确定，此处不作重构。

items.example: It supplies English interpret.
It forms interpretation.
It forms interpreter.
It forms interpretive.
It forms misinterpret.
The second half begins as a physical slope.
The second half names the distortion.

items.meaning: a systematic habit of assigning meaning
items.meaningCN: 赋予意义的系统性习惯
items.example: The compound names the reading, not the text.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合词命名阅读方式，而非文本。

latinEntries.structure: interpretari, interpretatus sum (verb, deponent, first conjugation)

由解释动词加表示动作的名词尾构成，义为「解释；诠释」

definition_zh: 催化的；起催化作用的；催化性的；有促进作用的
definition_en: relating to or acting as a catalyst, or describing a device or process that uses catalysis
core_image: 一层薄薄的金属涂层：废气穿过它，分子被拆开重组，涂层本身却毫发无损
scene: 修车厂里，师傅指着排气管中段说： This is the catalytic converter; the honeycomb inside is coated with platinum.
sceneCN: 这里指第 1 个义项。这里 catalytic 是「催化的、催化式的」（第 1、2 个义项：催化作用与催化转化器）；句意：这是催化转化器，里面的蜂窝状载体镀了铂。图中可辨识物件：排气管、蜂窝载体、铂涂层、扳手。

pos.zh: （比喻）有促进作用的；促成变化的

derivatives.zh: 以催化方式；通过催化作用

senses.title: Relating to catalysis
senses.definition: concerning the process by which a substance speeds up a reaction without being consumed
senses.definitionCN: 关于某物质加快反应而自身不被消耗这一过程的
senses.example: The team studies catalytic processes for making fertilizer.
senses.exampleCN: 这个团队研究制造肥料的催化过程。
senses.why: Catalytic is simply catalyst plus the adjective suffix -ic. Its first job is to name the whole domain of catalysis, without pointing to any particular substance.
senses.whyCN: catalytic 就是 catalyst 加形容词后缀 -ic。它最初的任务是命名催化这一整个领域，而不指向某种具体物质。

senses.title: The catalytic converter
senses.definition: describing an exhaust device that uses a catalyst to turn harmful gases into less harmful ones
senses.definitionCN: 描述用催化剂把有害气体转为较无害气体的排气装置
senses.example: Cars sold here must have a catalytic converter.
senses.exampleCN: 这里销售的汽车必须装有催化转化器。
senses.why: The adjective became a fixed part of the device's name. A converter is not itself a catalyst; it is a container whose work is catalytic.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词成了装置名称的固定部分。转化器本身不是催化剂，它是一个容器，而它的工作是催化的。

senses.title: Catalytic cracking in refining
senses.definition: describing the refinery process that breaks heavy oil into lighter fuels with the help of a catalyst
senses.definitionCN: 描述炼油中借助催化剂把重油裂解为轻质燃料的过程
senses.example: Catalytic cracking increased the yield of petrol.
senses.exampleCN: 催化裂化提高了汽油产率。
senses.why: The process is named by its means, not its product. Cracking was already a thermal process; adding a catalyst changed the name and the economics.
senses.whyCN: 这个过程以手段而非产物命名。裂化原本是热过程；加入催化剂改变了名称，也改变了经济性。

senses.title: Acting as an enabler
senses.definition: in general usage, describing something that makes a change possible without being the main cause
senses.definitionCN: 一般用法中描述使变化成为可能、而自身不是主因的事物
senses.example: The treaty had a catalytic effect on regional trade.
senses.exampleCN: 这项条约对区域贸易产生了催化作用。
senses.why: The metaphor keeps the chemistry exact: the adjective describes a role, not a magnitude. A catalytic event is small relative to what it sets off.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻保持了化学的精确：形容词描述的是角色，不是大小。一个催化性事件相对于它所启动的事情而言是小的。

senses.title: Having catalytic properties
senses.definition: of a material or surface, able to accelerate a reaction because of its own structure
senses.definitionCN: 指材料或表面因自身结构而能加快反应
senses.example: The nanoparticles have strong catalytic properties.
senses.exampleCN: 这些纳米颗粒具有很强的催化性质。
senses.why: Here the adjective moves from the process to the material. A surface is catalytic when the reaction happens on it, at its active sites.
senses.whyCN: 这里形容词从过程转向材料。当反应在其活性位点上发生时，这个表面就是催化的。

senses.title: Driving economic growth
senses.definition: in economics, describing an investment or sector that stimulates further activity
senses.definitionCN: 经济中指刺激更多活动的投资或部门
senses.example: Infrastructure spending has a catalytic role in the economy.
senses.exampleCN: 基础设施支出在经济中具有催化作用。
senses.why: Investment is imagined as a substance that lowers the barrier to other investment. The adjective marks leverage rather than size.
senses.whyCN: 投资被想象成一种降低其他投资障碍的物质。这个形容词标示的是杠杆作用，而不是规模。

senses.title: Setting off social change
senses.definition: describing an event, person or idea that starts a wider movement
senses.definitionCN: 描述启动更广泛运动的事件、人或观念
senses.example: The photograph played a catalytic role in the reform movement.
senses.exampleCN: 这张照片在改革运动中起了催化作用。
senses.why: The barrier here is social inertia. A catalytic idea does not do the organising; it makes organising possible.
senses.whyCN: 这里的障碍是社会惰性。一个催化性的观念并不亲自组织，它使组织成为可能。

senses.title: Enzyme-catalysed
senses.definition: in biochemistry, describing a reaction that takes place with the help of an enzyme
senses.definitionCN: 生物化学中描述在酶帮助下发生的反应
senses.example: The pathway consists of several enzyme-catalytic steps.
senses.exampleCN: 这条途径由若干酶催化的步骤组成。
senses.why: The adjective attaches to the step, not the enzyme. A catalytic step is one whose rate is governed by a biological catalyst.
senses.whyCN: 形容词附着在步骤上，而不是酶上。一个催化步骤，就是速率由生物催化剂支配的步骤。

senses.title: Taking place under catalysis
senses.definition: describing a reaction or transformation that requires a catalyst to proceed at a useful rate
senses.definitionCN: 描述需要催化剂才能以有用速率进行的反应或转化
senses.example: The industrial route is entirely catalytic.
senses.exampleCN: 这条工业路线完全是催化式的。
senses.why: This sense is the most technical and the least metaphorical: the adjective classifies a reaction by its mechanism. Without the catalyst, the rate would be impractically slow.
senses.whyCN: 这一义最技术化、最少比喻：形容词按机理给反应分类。没有催化剂，速率会慢到无法实用。

intro.en: Catalytic is one step downstream from catalyst: the noun plus the adjective suffix -ic. Its history is therefore shorter than the history of catalysis, and its interest lies in how a suffix turned a substance into a whole class of processes and devices.
intro.cn: catalytic 是 catalyst 下游的一步：名词加形容词后缀 -ic。因此它的历史比 catalysis 短，而它的趣味在于：一个后缀如何把一种物质变成一整类过程与装置。

items.en: The root lyein 'to loosen' supplies the -lyt- inside catalytic. The same root appears in analysis, electrolysis and hydrolysis.
items.cn: 词根 lyein“松开”提供了 catalytic 内部的 -lyt-。同一词根出现在 analysis、electrolysis、hydrolysis 中。

items.en: Berzelius coined catalysis from Greek katalysis for the phenomenon of accelerating a reaction without being consumed. The process was named before any single agent had a name.
items.cn: 贝采利乌斯在 1835 年据希腊语 katalysis 造出 catalysis，命名“加快反应而自身不被消耗”的现象。过程先于任何单一施动者获得名称。

items.en: Catalyst was formed later, on the model of analysis and analyst, to name the substance itself. Only after the noun existed could an adjective be built on it.
items.cn: catalyst 更晚出现，仿照 analysis 与 analyst 的模型，用来命名物质本身。只有名词存在之后，才能在其上构成形容词。

items.en: Catalytic is catalyst plus -ic, from Greek -ikos through Latin -icus, meaning 'belonging to, having the nature of'. The adjective first meant simply 'of a catalyst'.
items.cn: catalytic 是 catalyst 加 -ic，后者经拉丁语 -icus 来自希腊语 -ikos，意为“属于……的、具有……性质的”。这个形容词最初只表示“属于催化剂的”。

items.en: The adjective became a fixed element in names of hardware and processes: catalytic converter, catalytic cracking, catalytic site. Each compound names an object or step by the role catalysis plays in it.
items.cn: 这个形容词成了硬件与工艺名称中的固定成分：催化转化器、催化裂化、催化位点。每个复合词都按催化在其中扮演的角色来命名对象或步骤。

items.en: Since the mid-20th century catalytic has also worked outside chemistry, describing investments, policies and people that enable change. The suffix now marks a role rather than a substance.
items.cn: 自 20 世纪中期起，catalytic 也走出化学，用来描述促成变化的投资、政策与人。这个后缀如今标示的是一种角色，而不是一种物质。

note.en: The first group is mostly family: base noun, rare variant, and one Greek-look-alike from a different root. The second group compares words for enabling change.
note.cn: 第一组主要是同族词：基础名词、罕见异体，以及一个来自别的词根的希腊式形近词。第二组比较“促成变化”类词。

entries.definition: the substance or agent itself. Catalytic describes it or its role; catalyst names it.
entries.definitionCN: 物质或施动者本身。catalytic 描述它或其角色，catalyst 命名它。

entries.definition: an older and rarer adjective form with -al added to -ic. It means the same as catalytic.
entries.definitionCN: 在 -ic 上再加 -al 的较旧、较罕见形容词形式，意义与 catalytic 相同。

entries.definition: a stone-throwing engine. Its second element has nothing to do with loosening, despite the shared kata- beginning.
entries.definitionCN: 投石机。尽管同样以 kata- 开头，其第二成分与“松开”无关。

entries.definition: important in causing something to happen. It stresses usefulness to an outcome, while catalytic stresses the enabling mechanism.
entries.definitionCN: 在促成某事上起重要作用的。它强调对结果的用处，而 catalytic 强调促成机制。

entries.definition: acting as the cause of something. It is stronger and more direct than catalytic, which implies a lowered barrier rather than a sole cause.
entries.definitionCN: 作为某事的成因起作用的。它比 catalytic 更强、更直接，后者暗示降低障碍而非唯一原因。

entries.definition: tending to help something happen. It describes a favourable condition, not an active agent.
entries.definitionCN: 有助于某事发生的。它描述有利条件，而非主动施动者。

entries.definition: giving someone the means or authority to act. It is broader than catalytic and often institutional.
entries.definitionCN: 给某人行动的手段或权限。它比 catalytic 更宽，常带制度色彩。

normalIntro.en: These hooks show the suffix step from noun to adjective and attach the adjective to its fixed technical phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩展示从名词到形容词的后缀一步，并把形容词系到固定的技术搭配上。

normal.en: See the build: catalyst + -ic. The adjective adds nothing but 'of or having the nature of'.
normal.cn: 看见构成：catalyst 加 -ic。形容词只加了“属于……的、具有……性质的”。

normal.en: Remember the -lyt- core: it is the loosening root shared with analysis.
normal.cn: 记住 -lyt- 核心：它与 analysis 共享“松开”词根。

normal.en: Pair it with converter: a catalytic converter is a box whose job is catalytic.
normal.cn: 与 converter 配对：催化转化器是一个工作性质为催化的盒子。

normal.en: Use cracking for the refinery image: heavy oil broken into lighter fuel over a catalyst.
normal.cn: 用 cracking 记炼油意象：重油在催化剂上裂解为轻质燃料。

normal.en: For the metaphor, say 'catalytic role': the word marks a role, not a size.
normal.cn: 记比喻时用 catalytic role：这个词标示角色，不标示大小。

abstract.en: Hold one step: noun to adjective by -ic, substance to role by metaphor.
abstract.cn: 抓住两步：名词靠 -ic 变形容词，物质靠比喻变角色。

abstract.en: Sort the senses by what is described: process, device, material, economy, society, enzyme, mechanism.
abstract.cn: 按被描述的对象分组：过程、装置、材料、经济、社会、酶、机理。

abstract.en: Remember that catalytic never names the catalyst; it names what the catalyst does.
abstract.cn: 记住 catalytic 从不命名催化剂本身，它命名催化剂所做的事。

examples.en: The catalytic activity of the surface depends on its structure.
examples.cn: 该表面的催化活性取决于其结构。

examples.en: Modern refineries rely on catalytic cracking.
examples.cn: 现代炼油厂依赖催化裂化。

examples.en: Her early work had a catalytic effect on the field.
examples.cn: 她的早期工作对该领域产生了催化作用。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音“开特利提克”：想象“开”一扇门靠“特”别“利”害的“提克”小装置——它只帮忙开门，自己不进门，就是 catalytic 催化的。

root: 英语名词 catalyst 加形容词后缀 -ic（经拉丁语 -icus 来自希腊语 -ikos“属于……的”）；catalyst 出自希腊语 katalysis“消解”，由 kata-“向下”加 lyein“松开”构成。

sensesIntro.en: Catalytic is the adjective of a role. In chemistry it classifies processes, surfaces and devices by how they use a catalyst; outside chemistry it classifies people, policies and events by how they enable change. In every sense the word answers 'in what way is catalysis involved', never 'which catalyst'.
sensesIntro.cn: catalytic 是一个角色的形容词。在化学中，它按“如何使用催化剂”来分类过程、表面与装置；在化学之外，它按“如何促成变化”来分类人、政策与事件。无论哪一义，这个词回答的都是“催化以何种方式介入”，而不是“是哪种催化剂”。

core.en: Of or by catalysis: describing whatever lowers a barrier without being consumed.
core.cn: 催化的、借催化而成的：描述任何降低障碍而自身不被消耗的事物。

branches.en: PROCESS: the general domain of catalysis and reactions that require it.
branches.cn: 过程：催化的一般领域以及需要它的反应。

branches.en: REFINING: catalytic cracking breaks heavy oil into lighter fuel.
branches.cn: 炼油：催化裂化把重油裂解为轻质燃料。

branches.en: MATERIAL AND STEP: catalytic surfaces, sites and enzyme-catalysed steps.
branches.cn: 材料与步骤：催化表面、位点与酶催化的步骤。

branches.en: ROLE: investments, treaties and ideas that enable wider change.
branches.cn: 角色：促成更广泛变化的投资、条约与观念。

branches.en: EVERYDAY OBJECT: the car part most people know by this adjective.
branches.cn: 日常物件：大多数人通过这个形容词认识的汽车部件。

intro.en: Catalytic is a textbook case of suffix stacking: a Greek-rooted noun takes Latin -icus and English -ic, then -ly and compound nouns grow on top. The list follows that growth.
intro.cn: catalytic 是后缀叠加的教科书案例：希腊词根名词接拉丁 -icus 与英语 -ic，再在上面长出 -ly 与复合名词。清单沿着这条生长线展开。

latinIntro.en: The Latin entries are learned or Neo-Latin forms: the Greek-rooted nouns as Latinized in European science, plus the Neo-Latin adjective catalyticus. They are included to show how the Greek root entered Latin vocabulary.
latinIntro.cn: 下列拉丁条目是学术拉丁或新拉丁形式：希腊词根名词在欧洲科学中的拉丁化形态，以及新拉丁形容词 catalyticus。列出它们是为了展示希腊词根如何进入拉丁词汇。

items.meaning: of a catalyst; acting by catalysis
items.meaningCN: 催化剂的；借催化作用的
items.example: The reaction needs a catalytic surface.
items.exampleCN: 这个反应需要催化表面。

items.meaning: the substance that enables the reaction
items.example: The catalyst is not consumed.
Catalysis speeds up the industrial process.

items.meaning: to make a reaction proceed by catalysis
items.example: The metal catalyzes the decomposition.
items.exampleCN: 这种金属催化该分解反应。

items.example: The exhaust is treated catalytically.
Older texts use the catalytical form.
items.exampleCN: 较早的文献使用 catalytical 这一形式。

items.meaning: an exhaust device that cleans gases by catalysis
items.example: The catalytic converter cuts nitrogen oxides.
items.exampleCN: 催化转化器减少氮氧化物。

items.meaning: refining that breaks heavy oil with a catalyst
items.example: Catalytic cracking produces lighter fuels.
items.exampleCN: 催化裂化产出更轻的燃料。

items.meaning: the place on a surface where the reaction occurs
items.example: Each catalytic site binds one molecule.
items.exampleCN: 每个催化位点结合一个分子。

items.example: The biocatalytic route avoids harsh solvents.
items.exampleCN: 生物催化路线避免了苛刻溶剂。

definition_zh: 陶瓷工艺；陶瓷制品；陶瓷学
definition_en: the art and science of making ceramic ware; ceramic objects taken as a group
core_image: 工作室的长桌上摆着拉坯机、釉料桶和一排素坯，墙上贴着烧成曲线图
scene: 这门课程要求学生先学会拉坯，再研究釉料在高温下的变化。 The ceramics course teaches students to throw pots before they study glazes.
sceneCN: 这里 ceramics 指「陶瓷工艺这门学科」（第 4 个义项：作为课程或研究领域的陶瓷艺术与科学）；句意为这门陶瓷课程要求学生先学会拉坯，再研究釉料。图中可辨识物件：拉坯机、釉料桶、素坯、烧成曲线图。

pos.zh: 陶瓷工艺；陶瓷学（作单数）

derivatives.zh: 陶瓷的；陶瓷制品（去掉学科后缀 -s）
以陶瓷方式；在陶瓷方面

senses.title: The art of making ceramic ware
senses.definition: the art and craft of shaping clay and firing it into vessels or figures
senses.definitionCN: 把黏土塑形并烧制成器皿或造型的艺术与手艺
senses.example: She studied ceramics in Kyoto for two years.
senses.exampleCN: 她在京都学了两年陶瓷。
senses.why: the plural form was taken from the adjective ceramic and used as the name of the whole art.
senses.whyCN: 这个复数形式取自「陶瓷的」这一形容词，被用作整门艺术的名称。

senses.title: Ceramic objects taken as a group
senses.definition: objects made of fired clay or porcelain, considered collectively
senses.definitionCN: 用陶土或瓷土烧成的物件，作为整体看待
senses.example: The tomb yielded ceramics from three different periods.
senses.exampleCN: 这座墓出土了三个不同时期的陶瓷。
senses.why: the ordinary plural of ceramic simply names more than one object, so it doubles as a collective label.
senses.whyCN: 「陶瓷的」这一形容词的普通复数本只表示不止一件器物，因此也兼作集合名称。

senses.title: Engineered ceramic materials
senses.definition: hard, heat-resistant inorganic materials developed for industrial use
senses.definitionCN: 为工业用途开发的坚硬耐热无机材料
senses.example: Advanced ceramics outperform steel in the bearing.
senses.exampleCN: 在这种轴承里，先进陶瓷的性能超过钢材。
senses.why: materials science uses the plural as a mass label for a class of engineered solids.
senses.whyCN: 材料科学用这个复数作为一整类工程固体的不可数标签。

senses.title: The academic discipline or course
senses.definition: the field of study or a taught course concerned with ceramic materials and art
senses.definitionCN: 研究陶瓷材料与艺术的研究领域或开设的课程
senses.example: Ceramics is a required course for conservation students.
senses.exampleCN: 陶瓷学是修复专业学生的必修课。
senses.why: English names many disciplines with a plural ending and a singular verb, as with physics and economics.
senses.whyCN: 英语常用复数词尾配单数动词来命名学科，如物理学与经济学。

senses.title: Ceramic finds studied in archaeology
senses.definition: fired clay objects recovered from sites and used to date and compare cultures
senses.definitionCN: 从遗址出土、用于断代和文化比较的烧制陶器
senses.example: The site's ceramics place it in the Iron Age.
senses.exampleCN: 该遗址的陶瓷把它定在铁器时代。
senses.why: archaeologists shortened 'ceramic objects' to ceramics because fired clay survives and can be classified.
senses.whyCN: 考古学家把「陶瓷器物」简称为 ceramics，因为烧制陶器易于留存且可分类。

senses.title: The ceramics industry
senses.definition: the sector of manufacturing that produces tiles, tableware and technical ceramic goods
senses.definitionCN: 生产瓷砖、餐具与技术陶瓷制品的制造业部门
senses.example: The region's ceramics employ thousands of workers.
senses.exampleCN: 该地区的陶瓷工业雇用数千名工人。
senses.why: industry reporting treats the plural as the name of a sector, like textiles or plastics.
senses.whyCN: 产业报道把这个复数当作部门名称，如同纺织业与塑料业。

senses.title: Dental and medical ceramics
senses.definition: ceramic materials used to rebuild teeth or to make medical implants
senses.definitionCN: 用于修复牙齿或制造医疗植入体的陶瓷材料
senses.example: Modern dentistry relies on ceramics for crowns.
senses.exampleCN: 现代牙科依靠陶瓷制作牙冠。
senses.why: dentists use the plural as a material category because several ceramic systems are in use.
senses.whyCN: 牙医使用这个复数作为材料类别，因为在用的陶瓷体系不止一种。

senses.title: Glazes and protective ceramic layers
senses.definition: glassy or ceramic coatings applied to a surface for protection or decoration
senses.definitionCN: 为保护或装饰而施加于表面的玻璃质或陶瓷涂层
senses.example: The engine runs hotter because its ceramics insulate the metal.
senses.exampleCN: 由于陶瓷层隔热，这台发动机能在更高温度下运转。
senses.why: coatings are ceramic too, so the plural extends from solid ware to thin protective layers.
senses.whyCN: 涂层同样是陶瓷，因此这个复数从实体器物扩展到薄薄的保护层。

intro.en: Ceramics is the English plural of ceramic, from Greek keramikos 'of pottery', and was adopted in the nineteenth century as the name of the art and science. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: ceramics 是 ceramic 的英语复数，源自希腊 keramikos「陶器的」，在十九世纪被采用为这门艺术与科学的名称。年代均为约数。

items.en: Keramos meant potter's clay and pottery; its deeper origin is uncertain, and both a pre-Greek source and a link to kerannynai 'to mix' are hypotheses.
items.cn: keramos 指陶土与陶器；其更深来源不确定，源自前希腊语与联系到 kerannynai「混合」都只是假说。

items.en: The adjective keramikos 'of pottery' described clay ware and the potters' quarter of Athens.
items.cn: 形容词 keramikos「陶器的」用于描述陶制器物，也指雅典的陶工区。

items.en: Learned Latin used ceramica as a noun for pottery, keeping the Greek root that English later borrowed.
items.cn: 学术拉丁语用 ceramica 作为「陶器」的名词，保留了英语后来借用的希腊词根。

items.en: Nineteenth-century English adopted ceramic as the technical term, and the plural ceramics became the name of the field.
items.cn: 十九世纪英语采用 ceramic 作为技术术语，其复数 ceramics 成为该领域的名称。

items.en: Twentieth-century engineering extended ceramics to advanced materials, coatings and medical implants.
items.cn: 二十世纪工程学把 ceramics 扩展到先进材料、涂层与医用植入体。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin): the pre-Greek history of keramos is not settled, so any older form offered for it is a reconstruction.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源）：keramos 的前希腊语历史尚无定论，为它提出的更早形态均属重构形式。

note.en: Group one holds forms that differ only by an ending but belong to different word classes; group two holds ware names that are not interchangeable with ceramics.
note.cn: 第一组只差词尾、却属于不同词类的词形；第二组是不可与 ceramics 随意互换的器物名称。

entries.definition: The adjective 'of fired clay' or a singular countable object; ceramics is the field or the mass of objects.
entries.definitionCN: 意为「陶制的」的形容词，或单件可数制品；ceramics 则是学科或器物总称。

entries.definition: A person who makes or studies ceramics; the ending -ist marks a person, not a subject.
entries.definitionCN: 制作或研究陶瓷的人；词尾 -ist 标出人，而非学科。

entries.definition: A rival formation for the same person noun, built on ceramic plus -ist rather than on ceram-.
entries.definitionCN: 同一指人名词的另一种构法，在 ceramic 上加 -ist，而非在 ceram- 上加。

entries.definition: The protein of hair and nails, from Greek keras 'horn'; the resemblance to ceramics is accidental.
entries.definitionCN: 毛发与指甲中的蛋白质，来自希腊 keras「角」；与 ceramics 的相似纯属偶然。

entries.definition: The everyday word for fired clay ware and its craft; ceramics is the technical and industrial umbrella.
entries.definitionCN: 指烧制陶器及其手艺的日常词；ceramics 是技术与工业上的总称。

entries.definition: Porous, low-fired clay ware, usually glazed; it is one category within ceramics.
entries.definitionCN: 多孔、低温烧成的陶器，通常上釉；是 ceramics 中的一个类别。

entries.definition: Dense, waterproof clay ware fired at a higher temperature; another single category.
entries.definitionCN: 较高温度烧成、致密防水的陶器；同属单一类别。

entries.definition: White, translucent high-fired ware; the most refined product within ceramics.
entries.definitionCN: 白色半透明的高温瓷器；是 ceramics 中最精细的产品。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real course and industry phrases, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实课程与产业短语，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: ceramic plus -s: the plural ending turns an adjective into a field name, as with physics.
normal.cn: ceramic 加 -s：复数词尾把形容词变成学科名，如同物理学。

normal.en: The subject takes a singular verb: ceramics is taught here.
normal.cn: 这个学科名接单数动词：陶瓷学在这里教授。

normal.en: Industry phrases mark the material sense: advanced ceramics, technical ceramics.
normal.cn: 产业短语标出材料义：先进陶瓷、技术陶瓷。

normal.en: The family runs ceramic, ceramics, ceramist, ceramicist.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 ceramic、ceramics、ceramist、ceramicist。

normal.en: Archaeology says the site's ceramics when it means the pots found there.
normal.cn: 考古学用 the site's ceramics 指在那里发现的陶器。

abstract.en: Picture a shelf of pots that becomes a library of dates.
abstract.cn: 想象一排陶罐变成一座年代图书馆。

abstract.en: Picture a craft that splits into an art studio and a factory floor.
abstract.cn: 想象一门手艺分成艺术工作室与工厂车间。

abstract.en: Picture a discipline with a singular name built from a plural ending.
abstract.cn: 想象一门学科，名字由复数词尾构成，却按单数使用。

examples.en: The museum's ceramics gallery reopened after restoration.
examples.cn: 博物馆的陶瓷展厅修复后重新开放。

examples.en: Ceramics is taught alongside glassblowing in the craft school.
examples.cn: 这所工艺学校把陶瓷与吹玻璃一起教授。

examples.en: The firm supplies ceramics for jet engine components.
examples.cn: 这家公司为喷气发动机部件供应陶瓷。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「ceramic（陶瓷的）+ s」——陶瓷这门学问与这批器物 → 陶瓷工艺

root: 希腊 keramos「陶土」→ keramikos「陶器的」→ 拉丁 ceramica「陶器」→ 英语 ceramic 加 -s 构成学科名 ceramics。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses run from the studio to the factory: the art, the objects, engineered materials, the course, the dig, the industry, the clinic and the coating.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从工作室走到工厂：艺术、器物、工程材料、课程、考古发掘、产业、诊所与涂层。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one craft splitting into art, science and industry while keeping the same clay at its base.
core.cn: 核心意象：一门手艺分化为艺术、科学与工业，底部仍是同一种黏土。

branches.en: ART AND STUDY: the same plural names a studio art and a taught discipline with a singular verb.
branches.cn: 艺术与学问：同一个复数既指工作室艺术，也指接单数动词的学科。

branches.en: OBJECTS: whole collections and excavated finds are both called ceramics.
branches.cn: 器物：整批藏品与出土遗物都被称作 ceramics。

branches.en: MATERIALS: engineered solids and thin protective coatings share the ceramic base.
branches.cn: 材料：工程固体与薄保护层共享陶瓷基底。

branches.en: SECTOR: the plural becomes the name of an industry, like textiles or plastics.
branches.cn: 产业：这个复数成为一个行业名称，如同纺织业与塑料业。

branches.en: CLINIC: dental and medical ceramics apply the material to the body.
branches.cn: 诊所：牙科与医用陶瓷把这种材料用于身体。

intro.en: Ceramics is the Greek clay root plus a Greek adjective ending plus an English plural used as a subject name.
intro.cn: ceramics 由希腊陶土词根、希腊形容词词尾，再加用作学科名的英语复数构成。

latinIntro.en: Learned Latin kept the Greek forms ceramicus and ceramica; English took ceramic from them and added -s for the field.
latinIntro.cn: 学术拉丁语保留希腊形式 ceramicus 与 ceramica；英语由此取得 ceramic，并加 -s 表示学科。

items.example: The root names the material of the craft.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根命名这门手艺的材料。

items.example: The suffix forms the adjective ceramic.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀构成形容词 ceramic。

items.example: The tile is ceramic, not stone.
items.exampleCN: 这块砖是陶制的，不是石头的。

items.meaning: a set, or a named field
items.example: The ending names both objects and the subject.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾既指器物，也指学科。

items.meaning: the art and science of ceramic ware
items.example: Ceramics is her major.
The ceramist built the vase by hand.
items.exampleCN: 这位陶艺家手工捏成花瓶。

items.example: A ceramicist judged the student show.
items.exampleCN: 一位陶艺家评审学生作品展。

items.example: The layers are ceramically bonded.
Technical ceramics resist wear at high speed.
items.exampleCN: 技术陶瓷在高速下耐磨损。

definition_zh: 表述；制定；配方；公式表达
definition_en: the act of expressing an idea precisely, or the particular mixture and wording that results
core_image: 一张纸上先写出一句精确的话，旁边再排出配比表
scene: 这里指「表述」。 The formulation of the policy took months of drafting and redrafting.
sceneCN: 这里 formulation 是「制定、表述」（第 1 个义项：把想法整理成明确文字）；句意：这项政策的制定花了几个月反复起草。图中可辨识物件：草稿纸、修改批注、会议桌、印章。

senses.title: Putting an idea into exact words
senses.titleCN: 表述：把想法压成一句准话
senses.definition: the act of expressing a thought or plan in clear, precise language
senses.definitionCN: 用清楚、精确的语言表达思想或计划的行为
senses.example: The formulation of the question decided what could count as an answer.
senses.exampleCN: 问题的表述方式决定了什么才算答案。
senses.why: formula is a small form. Formulation gives an idea a definite shape in words, the way a mold gives metal a shape.
senses.whyCN: formula 是“小形式”。formulation 用文字给想法一个确定形状，就像模具给金属一个形状。

senses.title: Drafting a policy
senses.titleCN: 制定：把政策一条条写出来
senses.definition: the process of designing and writing a policy, strategy or plan
senses.definitionCN: 设计并写出政策、战略或计划的过程
senses.example: The formulation of the new tax rules involved three ministries.
senses.exampleCN: 新税则的制定涉及三个部委。
senses.why: Policy does not exist until it is written down. Formulation is the moment an intention acquires clauses, numbers and a signature line.
senses.whyCN: 政策在写下来之前并不存在。formulation 就是意图获得条款、数字与签字栏的那一刻。

senses.title: A chemical recipe
senses.definition: a specific mixture of ingredients and their proportions, especially in medicine or industry
senses.definitionCN: 成分及其比例的特定混合，尤用于医药或工业
senses.example: The new formulation dissolves faster and tastes less bitter.
senses.exampleCN: 新配方溶解更快，苦味也更少。
senses.why: This is the most concrete sense: the formula is a list of quantities. The word names both the list and the resulting product.
senses.whyCN: 这是最具体的义项：formula 是一张数量清单。这个词既命名清单，也命名产物。

senses.title: Stating it as a formula
senses.titleCN: 公式表达：把关系写成符号
senses.definition: the expression of a relationship in mathematical symbols
senses.definitionCN: 用数学符号表达某种关系
senses.example: The formulation of the model uses two variables and one constant.
senses.exampleCN: 该模型的公式表达使用两个变量和一个常数。
senses.why: Mathematics strips the idea to symbols. The same 'give it a form' act now produces an equation rather than a sentence.
senses.whyCN: 数学把想法剥到符号层。同一个“给它一个形式”的动作，现在产出的是方程而不是句子。

senses.title: Building a theory
senses.titleCN: 理论建构：把假设搭成体系
senses.definition: the construction of a theory or hypothesis in a defined and testable form
senses.definitionCN: 以明确且可检验的形式构建理论或假设
senses.example: Her formulation of the problem avoided the usual assumption of perfect information.
senses.exampleCN: 她对问题的理论建构避开了常见的完全信息假设。
senses.why: A theory is formulation all the way down: assumptions, definitions and predictions are all given form before anything can be tested.
senses.whyCN: 理论从头到尾都是 formulation：假设、定义与预测都必须先获得形式，才谈得上检验。

senses.title: The finished product form
senses.titleCN: 剂型：做成药片还是液体
senses.definition: the physical form in which a medicine or product is supplied
senses.definitionCN: 药品或产品供应的物理形态
senses.example: The same drug is sold in tablet and liquid formulations.
senses.exampleCN: 同一种药有片剂和液剂两种剂型。
senses.why: Here formulation means the shape the product finally takes. The active ingredient is the same; the form is the difference.
senses.whyCN: 这里 formulation 指产品最终采取的形状。有效成分相同，差别在形式。

senses.title: Setting out a problem
senses.titleCN: 问题形式化：先把题目写清楚
senses.definition: the formal statement of a problem so that it can be solved or computed
senses.definitionCN: 为使问题可解或可计算而作的正式陈述
senses.example: A good formulation often makes the solution obvious.
senses.exampleCN: 一个好的问题表述常让解法变得显然。
senses.why: This sense treats formulation as half the solution. Once the problem is stated in the right variables, the hard part is already done.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项把 formulation 当作解法的一半。一旦用正确的变量表述问题，难的部分已经完成。

senses.title: A statement repeated as a formula
senses.definition: a fixed phrase used repeatedly, often losing its original force
senses.definitionCN: 被反复使用、常失去原有力量的固定说法
senses.example: The minister's formulation about 'shared responsibility' satisfied nobody.
senses.exampleCN: 部长那句关于“共同责任”的套话谁也没说服。
senses.why: A formulation can harden into a formula. What was once a precise shaping becomes a ready-made block dropped into any speech.
senses.whyCN: formulation 会硬化成 formula。曾经精确的塑形，变成可以塞进任何演讲的现成积木。

intro.en: Formulation comes from formulate, from Latin formulare 'to form', built on formula, a diminutive of forma 'form, shape'. The word is about giving something a definite shape.
intro.cn: formulation 来自 formulate，而 formulate 出自拉丁 formulare“成形”，建立在 formula 之上，而 formula 是 forma“形式、形状”的指小形式。这个词讲的是给某物一个确定形状。

items.en: forma meant 'form, shape, mold'. It also meant 'beauty', because a well-shaped thing was thought beautiful; English form and formal descend from it.
items.cn: forma 意为“形式、形状、模具”。它也表示“美”，因为形状好的东西被认为美；英语 form、formal 由此而来。

items.en: formula was a small forma, 'a little shape'. In law it meant a fixed form of words, which is how the modern 'formula' sense began.
items.cn: formula 是“小形式”，即一个小 shape。在法律中它指固定的措辞格式，现代“公式”义正由此开始。

items.en: formulare 'to shape, to express in a fixed form' turns the noun into a verb. The verb covers both drafting a text and mixing a preparation.
items.cn: formulare“塑形、以固定形式表达”把名词变成动词。这个动词既涵盖起草文本，也涵盖配制混合物。

items.en: English formulate appears in the 19th century. It inherits both the verbal sense, to state precisely, and the chemical sense, to prepare by recipe.
items.cn: 英语 formulate 于 19 世纪出现。它继承了两种含义：精确陈述的言语义，以及按配方配制的化学义。

items.en: Formulation adds -ation, from Latin -atio, naming the process or its result. The noun is common in policy, pharmacy and mathematics.
items.cn: formulation 加 -ation（来自拉丁 -atio），命名过程或结果。这个名词常见于政策、药学与数学。

items.en: In the 20th century formulation becomes standard in policy and strategy writing, where it names the drafting stage before adoption.
items.cn: 20 世纪 formulation 成为政策与战略写作的标准词，命名通过之前的起草阶段。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the form- root but each adds a different suffix; the near-meaning group all involve putting something into a definite shape, verbal or material.
note.cn: 形近组共享 form- 词根，但各加不同后缀；近义组都涉及把某物放进确定形状，或言语或物质。

entries.definition: a fixed expression, recipe or equation. It is the shaped thing; formulation is the shaping act.
entries.definitionCN: 固定的说法、配方或公式。它是被塑成之物；formulation 是塑形行为。

entries.definition: to express precisely or to prepare by recipe. It is the action behind the noun.
entries.definitionCN: 确切表达；按配方配制。它是名词背后的动作。

entries.definition: the process of coming into being, as of a structure or group. It uses formare 'to form' directly, without the -ula diminutive.
entries.definitionCN: 形成、构成的过程，如结构或群体的形成。它直接用 formare“形成”，没有 -ula 指小成分。

entries.definition: the act of putting a thought into words. It is broader than formulation and less technical.
entries.definitionCN: 把想法放进文字的行为。它比 formulation 更宽泛，也更不技术化。

entries.definition: the particular words used to say something. It focuses on the verbal surface, not the underlying design.
entries.definitionCN: 用来表达某事的特定措辞。它聚焦言语表面，而非底层设计。

entries.definition: the act of combining parts into a whole, as in music or writing. It is broader and often artistic.
entries.definitionCN: 把部分合成整体，如音乐或写作。它更宽泛，常带艺术性。

entries.definition: the act of making something ready, especially a mixture. It covers the pharmacy sense but not the policy sense.
entries.definitionCN: 使某物准备好的行为，尤指配制混合物。它覆盖药学义，但不含政策义。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而不是编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: forma 'shape' + -ula 'little': a formula is a little shape, and formulation is giving an idea that shape.
normal.cn: forma“形状”+ -ula“小”：formula 是一个小形状，formulation 就是给想法这个形状。

normal.en: policy formulation and strategy formulation are the two standard policy collocations.
normal.cn: policy formulation 与 strategy formulation 是两个标准政策搭配。

normal.en: drug formulation is the pharmacy sense: same active ingredient, different physical form.
normal.cn: drug formulation 是药学义：同一有效成分，不同物理形态。

normal.en: A good mathematical formulation often solves half the problem before calculation starts.
normal.cn: 好的数学表述常在计算开始前就解决了一半问题。

normal.en: Note the pair formula and formulation: one is the fixed shape, the other the act of shaping.
normal.cn: 注意 formula 与 formulation 这一对：一个是固定形状，一个是塑形动作。

abstract.en: Think of clay pressed into a mold and lifted out with a clean edge.
abstract.cn: 想象黏土压进模具，取出时边缘干净。

abstract.en: Think of a long argument reduced to one sentence on an index card.
abstract.cn: 想象一段长论证被压缩成卡片上的一句话。

abstract.en: Think of a cook writing exact grams beside each ingredient, then handing the card to a factory.
abstract.cn: 想象厨师在每种配料旁写下精确克数，然后把卡片交给工厂。

examples.en: The formulation of the hypothesis took longer than the experiment itself.
examples.cn: 假设的表述比实验本身花的时间还长。

examples.en: The company changed the formulation to remove the artificial colour.
examples.cn: 公司修改配方，去掉了人工色素。

examples.en: Clear formulation is a courtesy to the reader.
examples.cn: 清晰的表述是对读者的礼貌。

dict_mnemonic.text: “form（形式）+ ulate”——给想法一个形式，再写出来 → formulation 表述、配方

root: 拉丁 forma“形式、形状” → formula（forma 的指小形式，固定措辞/配方）→ formulare“塑形、表述” → formulate + -ation。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses share one act: an idea or a substance is given a definite form, so that it can be repeated, tested or manufactured.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项共享一个动作：想法或物质被赋予确定形式，从而可以被重复、检验或制造。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: clay pressed into a mold.
core.cn: 核心意象：黏土被压进模具。

branches.en: WORDS: a precise statement and a hardened stock phrase are the same shaping, one still alive and one gone rigid.
branches.cn: 文字：精确表述与僵硬套话是同一种塑形，一个还活着，一个已硬化。

branches.en: POLICY: the drafting stage gives an intention clauses and numbers before adoption.
branches.cn: 政策：起草阶段在通过之前给意图配上条款与数字。

branches.en: MATTER: a recipe and a finished dosage form are the list and the resulting shape of the same mixture.
branches.cn: 物质：配方与最终剂型，是同一混合物的清单与成品形状。

branches.en: SYMBOLS: mathematical statement and formal problem setting reduce the idea to variables and constraints.
branches.cn: 符号：数学表述与问题形式化，把想法压缩成变量与约束。

branches.en: THEORY: assumptions, definitions and predictions are all given form before testing begins.
branches.cn: 理论：假设、定义与预测在检验开始前都必须获得形式。

intro.en: Formulation is formulate plus -ation. The form- stem means 'shape', -ula is a diminutive, -ate makes a verb and -ation names the process.
intro.cn: formulation 是 formulate 加 -ation。form- 词干意为“形状”，-ula 是指小成分，-ate 构成动词，-ation 命名过程。

latinIntro.en: The family runs from forma 'shape' to formula 'little shape, fixed wording' to formulare 'shape, express'. English relatives include form, formal, format and formulate.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词族从 forma“形状”到 formula“小形状、固定措辞”再到 formulare“塑形、表达”。英语同族词包括 form、formal、format、formulate。

items.meaning: to state precisely; to prepare by recipe
items.meaningCN: 确切表述；按配方配制（-ate 动词后缀）
items.example: The team formulated a clear hypothesis.
items.exampleCN: 团队提出了一个清晰的假设。

items.meaning: the act or result of shaping
items.meaningCN: 表述；制定；配方（-ation 过程名词）
items.example: The formulation was revised twice.
items.exampleCN: 这份表述被修改了两次。

items.meaning: a fixed phrase, recipe or equation
items.meaningCN: 公式；配方（forma 的指小形式）
items.example: The formula has three variables.

items.meaning: the shape or structure of something
items.meaningCN: 形式；形状（同一词根的基础名词）
items.example: Water takes the form of the container.

items.meaning: following an established shape or rule
items.meaningCN: 正式的；形式上的（-alis 关系形容词）
items.example: The letter was too formal for a friend.
items.exampleCN: 这封信对朋友来说太正式了。

items.meaning: the arrangement or layout of something
items.meaningCN: 格式；版式（-atus 事物名词）
items.example: The file format is not supported.

items.meaning: a book of approved formulas or medicines
items.meaningCN: 处方集；公式集（-ary 集合名词）
items.example: The hospital formulary lists two hundred drugs.
items.exampleCN: 医院处方集列出两百种药。

items.meaning: to state or prepare again in a new form
items.meaningCN: 重新表述；重新配制（re-“再次”）
items.example: They reformulated the question to avoid ambiguity.
items.exampleCN: 他们重新表述问题以避免歧义。

to shape, to express in a form

definition_zh: n. 背痛；腰痛（通常为持续性钝痛）
definition_en: A pain in the back, usually a dull and lasting one.
core_image: 直不起腰时后背那条隐隐的痛线
scene: 搬了一整天箱子，他晚上直不起腰。 Lifting boxes all day left him with a bad backache by evening.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：backache 指背部的疼痛，常作不可数名词。

senses.title: Pain in the back
senses.definition: a dull lasting pain anywhere along the back, treated as an uncountable condition
senses.definitionCN: 背部任何位置的持续钝痛，作不可数的身体状况看待
senses.example: She has had backache since the fall.
senses.exampleCN: 她自从那次跌倒后一直背痛。
senses.why: Backache joins back with ache, an old word for continuing pain, so it names a state rather than a sharp blow.
senses.whyCN: backache 由 back 与 ache 组成，ache 是指持续疼痛的旧词，因此它指一种状态而非一次剧痛。

senses.title: A bout of that pain
senses.definition: countably, one spell of such pain, as when a person speaks of recurrent aches
senses.definitionCN: 作可数用法时指一次这样的疼痛发作，如谈到反复发作的疼痛
senses.example: He gets backaches after long drives.
senses.exampleCN: 长途开车后他就会背痛发作。
senses.why: Because the condition returns in spells, speakers began counting the spells, giving the plural.
senses.whyCN: 因为这种状况会一阵阵回来，使用者开始数这些发作，于是有了复数。

intro.en: Backache is back plus ache; back is Old English baec, and ache comes from Old English acan, to ache, a native verb long confused in spelling with the noun.
intro.cn: backache 是 back 加 ache；back 是古英语 baec，ache 出自古英语 acan「疼痛」，这个本族动词的拼写长期与名词相混。

items.en: Old English baec meant the back of a body, the native word still in use.
items.cn: 古英语 baec 意为「身体的背部」，是沿用至今的本族词。

items.en: Old English acan was a verb meaning to give continuing pain.
items.cn: 古英语 acan 是动词，意为「持续作痛」。

items.en: Middle English had the verb ake and the noun ache, with different sounds.
items.cn: 中古英语有动词 ake 与名词 ache，读音不同。

items.en: Dr Johnson fixed the spelling ache for both, following the noun form.
items.cn: 约翰逊博士按名词形式把两者的拼写定为 ache。

items.en: Backache is recorded in the nineteenth century as complaints of work posture grew.
items.cn: 随着劳作姿势引起的病症增多，backache 于十九世纪有记载。

items.en: Today it appears in occupational health as lower back pain of mechanical origin.
items.cn: 今天它出现在职业健康领域，指力学原因引起的下背痛。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the ache compounds; the near-meaning group lists other words for pain in the trunk of the body.
note.cn: 形近组保留 ache 复合词；近义组列出表示躯干疼痛的其他词。

entries.definition: Pain in a tooth.
entries.definitionCN: 牙痛。

entries.definition: Pain in the head.
entries.definitionCN: 头痛。

entries.definition: The spine, or firmness of will.
entries.definitionCN: 脊柱；骨气。

entries.definition: Exhaustingly hard work.
entries.definitionCN: 累断腰的劳作。

entries.definition: Pain in the lower back.
entries.definitionCN: 下背部疼痛。

entries.definition: Difficulty in moving a joint.
entries.definitionCN: 关节活动困难。

entries.definition: Tender pain after effort.
entries.definitionCN: 用力后的酸痛。

entries.definition: Injury from overstretching.
entries.definitionCN: 过度拉伸造成的损伤。

normalIntro.en: Backache is back plus ache: a continuing dull pain along the back, and the plural counts its spells.
normalIntro.cn: backache 是 back 加 ache：沿背部的持续钝痛，复数则数它一次次发作。

normal.en: Usually uncountable: have backache.
normal.cn: 通常不可数：have backache。

normal.en: The plural counts separate spells.
normal.cn: 复数指一次次单独的发作。

normal.en: Lower backache is the commonest kind.
normal.cn: 下背痛是最常见的一种。

normal.en: Ache is dull; pain can be sharp.
normal.cn: ache 是钝痛，pain 可以是剧痛。

normal.en: Toothache and headache follow the pattern.
normal.cn: toothache 与 headache 遵循同一构词。

abstract.en: Picture a line of dull heat along the spine.
abstract.cn: 想象沿脊柱的一条闷热之线。

abstract.en: Imagine standing up only halfway.
abstract.cn: 想象只能直起一半的腰。

abstract.en: Think of a chair that never quite helps.
abstract.cn: 想象一把怎么坐都不解决问题的椅子。

examples.en: Backache kept her from the garden.
examples.cn: 背痛让她没法去花园。

examples.en: A firm mattress eased his backache.
examples.cn: 硬一点的床垫缓解了他的背痛。

examples.en: Repeated backaches forced him to stop lifting.
examples.cn: 反复的背痛发作迫使他不再搬重物。

dict_mnemonic.text: 拆件记忆：back「背」+ ache「持续作痛」——背上那条不断的钝痛，就是 backache；同法还有 toothache、headache。

root: 古英语 baec「背」与 acan「持续作痛」合成 backache；ache 的拼写在十八世纪按名词形式统一，十九世纪该复合词随劳作病症增多而通行。

sensesIntro.en: Both senses are the same dull line of pain: the lasting condition, and one spell of it counted separately.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项是同一条钝痛之线：持续的状况，以及被单独计数的一次发作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a dull line of pain along the back when you cannot stand straight
core.cn: 核心意象：直不起腰时后背那条隐隐的痛线

branches.en: A back sore after lifting boxes.
branches.cn: 搬箱后作痛的背。

branches.en: Pain lasting since a fall.
branches.cn: 自跌倒后持续的疼痛。

branches.en: Spells brought on by long drives.
branches.cn: 长途开车引发的发作。

branches.en: Repeated bouts that stop the lifting.
branches.cn: 反复到让人不再搬重物的发作。

branches.en: One condition, counted or not.
branches.cn: 同一状况，可计数或不计数。

intro.en: Backache is back plus ache; the same ache ending builds toothache and headache, while -breaking gives backbreaking.
intro.cn: backache 是 back 加 ache；同一 ache 词尾构成 toothache 与 headache，而 -breaking 则给出 backbreaking。

latinIntro.en: Both halves are native; Latin lumbus, loin, gives lumbago and lumbar, and dolor, pain, gives dolorous beside them.
latinIntro.cn: 两个部分都属本族语；拉丁语 lumbus「腰」产生 lumbago 与 lumbar，dolor「痛」则产生 dolorous。
